description:
S01 E02 — Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies
At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese; his next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

title: Made in Britain
description:
S01 E03 — Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf
Exploring the Lea and Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837; he heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, where he experiments with creating a new flavor.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Chinese Rockets
Rebuilding a 700-year-old multi-stage weapon brings multiple problems to Matt and Jeremy.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E09 — Arming Space Force
Exploring all the ways in which wars in space might be fought and who stands to make a pretty penny developing space-age weaponry.

title: The New Frontier
description:
The Cryosphere
New satellites are being launched to continue observations of Earth and its oceans and ice caps.
